verdict.rationale: Vestd provides EMI option scheme setup and granting (vestd-docs-6, vestd-docs-15, vestd-docs-25), board-ready governance/reporting with signatures (vestd-docs-18), and a dedicated 409A valuation service for issuing to US taxpayers (vestd-docs-16, vestd-docs-28), which together cover the major pieces of the story. However, no evidence shows these steps are chained into one single end-to-end workflow (board approval → 409A strike price lookup → grant issuance) triggered from a new-hire event; the docs describe separate features/pages rather than an integrated flow. Missing for 10: a documented single workflow linking board approval, 409A valuation retrieval, and option grant issuance in one pass, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this sequence works seamlessly end-to-end.
